categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively about land title registration. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement determining the ownership of specific land parcels, including details like parcel numbers, owner names, extent, and encumbrances. This fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "Any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters." It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized non-land categories.
